_comment: Copy this file to credentials.json and fill in your Google OAuth client. Use a Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client of type 'Desktop app' (installed) or 'Web application' (web). For a Web client, add the redirect URI http://localhost:4001/api/gmail/callback (match your PORT). Either the 'installed' or 'web' wrapper shape below works; you may also supply a flat object with client_id/client_secret. credentials.json is gitignored.
